How I work

A repeatable process, not a formula. The order stays, the depth flexes with the project.

1

Research

Talk to users, study the market and frame the problem before reaching for solutions.

→
2

Strategy

Define goals, scope and what success actually looks like for the project.

→
3

Wireframe

Sketch flows, structure information and test the logic before any pixels.

→
4

Design

Build the visual layer: type, colour, hierarchy and the polish that makes it feel right.

→
5

Prototype

Stitch it together. Make it click, swipe and breathe, closer to the real thing.

→
6

Iterate

Test, learn, refine. Shipping is the start, not the finish line.

→

The system behind this page

click a swatch to copy its hex

Aa
Bricolage Grotesque

Headlines. Heavy weight, condensed width, tight tracking.

Aa
Plus Jakarta Sans

Body, labels and interface text. Clear at every size.

Aa
Covered By Your Grace

Handwritten notes, used sparingly like margin comments.

2.5px line
Hard outlines

Every surface gets an outline and a flat offset shadow, no blur.

Three corner sizes

26px for big surfaces, 16px for small ones, full pills for chips and buttons.

Tape and tilt

Small rotations and tape pieces, as if it were pinned to a desk. A dotted, doodled pattern sits behind everything.
